<!-- Generated by scripts/docs-upgrade-page.mjs from spec/0.2/data/upgrade-map.json, spec/0.2/UPGRADING.md and scripts/docs-upgrade-page.json. Edit those, then run `npm run docs:upgrade:write`. -->

# Links, references and definitions {#links}

Definitions stand at column 0 outside quotes and items (C2-B-081), and a duplicate definition no longer replaces the first one. Reference labels may wrap across a line break, so hard-wrapping prose no longer turns a reference into literal brackets ([#1092](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/issues/1092)).

**U-038** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Definition inside a quote or an item

::: compare no-render
```text
> See [ref][].
>
> [ref]: https://example.com

Outside [ref][].
```
```crv
> See [ref][].

[ref]: https://example.com

Outside [ref][].
```
:::

**U-039** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Indented definition at the top level

::: compare no-render

```text
 [a]: /u
```
```crv
Text [a][].

[a]: /u
```
:::

**U-075** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> References that read the same

::: compare no-render
```text
See [^n](/u).

[^n]: Note.
```
```html
<p>See <a id="fnref1" href="#fn1" role="doc-noteref"><sup>1</sup></a>(/u).</p>
<section role="doc-endnotes" aria-label="Footnotes">
  <hr>
  <ol>
    <li id="fn1">
      <p>Note.<a href="#fnref1" role="doc-backlink" aria-label="Back to reference">↩</a></p>
    </li>
  </ol>
</section>
```
:::

**U-131** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-081 and C2-B-083, `* [d]:` writes an empty list item. A nested item with a definition can also leave a following colon line outside the list.
Tool: The tool replaces a consumed definition with `{% %}` and releases a following colon when the complete HTML check passes. Review other shapes.

::: compare no-render
```text
* [d]:
```
```html
<ul>
  <li>[d]:</li>
</ul>
```
:::

Tool: Review the definition.

```text

```
```html

```
:::

**U-134** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-032 and C2-B-081, `> [f]:` writes one empty block quote.

**U-158** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-H-085, the unresolved reference `[\[][]` is written as typed, backslash included, in 0.1.
Tool: Review the unresolved reference.

::: compare no-render
```text
[\[][]
```
```text
<p>[[][]</p> C2-H-085 renders the children of an unresolved reference, so an escape in its text is gone; 0.1 wrote the reference as typed.
```
:::

Tool: Review.

```text
b]
```


:::

**U-164** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-H-101 and C2-H-161: in 0.1, `[](⟨U+202E⟩javascript:)` writes `<p><a href="⟨U+202E⟩javascript:"></a></p>`. An authored attribute that is no URL sink, `*x*{k="..."}` with U+202E before `javascript:x`, kept its value in 0.1 too.
Tool: Review.

::: compare no-render
```text
[](⟨U+202E⟩javascript:)
```
```text
<p><a href=""></a></p> The same holds for an authored attribute that is no URL sink: `*x*{k="⟨U+202E⟩javascript:x"}` writes `<strong k="">`, where 0.1 wrote the value, since C2-H-161 removes the characters of `probe_removes` before it tests the scheme of any authored value. Without the control both engines write the value empty. No spelling keeps the 0.1 HTML.
```
:::

**U-206** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-H-095 and C2-H-096, `# *Setup*` then `See </#Setup>.` writes a link with a bold `Setup` label in 0.1.
Tool: Review the cross-reference display.

**U-221** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-069, a link with a quoted title crossing a line break writes a link whose HTML title contains that line break in 0.1.
Tool: Review the title; joining it onto one line gives a link whose title holds a space instead of the line break.

::: compare no-render
```text
[a](/u "t
u")
```
```text
The tail holds a line break and is no tail (C2-I-069), so the source is paragraph text.
```

**U-371** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-085 and C2-H-139, attribute blocks glued to an unresolved reference: `[x][no]{.c}{#i}`
Tool: Merged and written as one block in the fixed order, `<p>[x][no]{#i .c}</p>`, so the HTML is a function of the tree; candidate 7 had restored the typed form from a sidecar fact, which is gone. Review.

::: compare no-render
```text
[x][no]{.c}{#i}
```
```text
<p>[x][no]{#i .c}</p> An unresolved reference writes its glued attribute blocks merged, as one block in the fixed order (C2-I-085, C2-H-139), so the HTML is a function of the tree; 0.1 wrote them as typed, `<p>[x][no]{.c}{#i}</p>`. No rewrite is recorded; review.
```
:::
